finding.mechanism: MicroClayRetrieval.credit() mutates retrieval_entrypoint_policy before inserting its retrieval_feedback receipt. The prior _credit_tx() joined an already-open outer SQLite transaction without an inner rollback boundary. If the receipt INSERT raises, an outer caller catches that exception, and the outer transaction later commits, prior policy mutations can survive without the provenance/idempotency receipt.
finding.existing_test_gap: test_microclay_credit_crash_atomicity.py covers a standalone credit transaction whose exception rolls back the whole transaction; it does not cover a caught inner failure inside a still-live outer transaction.

repair.nested_behavior: create unique UUID-derived SQLite SAVEPOINT; ROLLBACK TO + RELEASE on BaseException; RELEASE on success
regression_contract: create canonical VERIFIED rewarding causal outcome
call credit() inside an outer UnifiedDB transaction and catch the inner sqlite error
require zero policy rows and zero feedback receipts after the caught inner failure
allow unrelated outer durable write to commit
remove injected failure and require one clean credit application
require duplicate retry to remain idempotent
